description: Implemented on stacked PR #814 branch. Reuse assessment: EXTEND existing TranslateKnowledgeQuery internal Jido Action and SearchKnowledgeBase tool; its existing ProviderSpec generation and Ingestion NodeRouter dispatch remain the only path. Retrieval LLM produces query plus required JSON lexical_terms; Pipeline forwards both; simple passes all caller terms unchanged and other languages translate them in one Action call; Ingestion trims/deduplicates without lexical-term count or per-term length truncation. Internal normalization is local-only, not a new Action; scope is Agent/SQL search, no workflow tool auto-exposure or identity change. Regression tests cover missing/malformed terms, >8 terms/name, long identifiers, translated output, normalization property, native/ParadeDB fixture tests. mix q passes, focused agent 60/60 + property, ingestion/tool integration 135/135 + properties, eval native and ParadeDB 11/11 each. mix precommit rerun fails broad suite 93/9798 tests; prior baseline on this branch failed 88/9793, including same untouched DiskDocument configuration test (returns :enoent vs expected :disk_channel_config_not_found). Keep draft PR; do not request final human approval until final gate passes. Per-language RRF rank is explicitly deferred.
title: [#814] Use LLM-authored lexical terms throughout knowledge search
